summary: RB Global filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, announcing its board authorized a $500 million increase to its normal course issuer bid (NCIB), doubling the repurchase program from $500 million to $1 billion, and obtained Toronto Stock Exchange approval to raise the maximum repurchasable shares. The amended NCIB permits repurchases of the lesser of 14,224,129 shares (about 10% of the public float as of March 6, 2026) or US$1 billion, effective September 17, 2026, terminating March 17, 2027. As of September 11, 2026, the company had repurchased 5,363,497 shares at roughly US$93.22 average. Watch execution pace and float reduction.
